facts.title: Hasselback Potatoes
ingredients: 4 to 6 medium Russet or yellow potatoes (7 to 9 ounces each)
1 stick (8 tablespoons) unsalted butter, at room temperature
2 medium cloves garlic, pressed or minced
Flaky sea salt or kosher salt, for sprinkling
Optional toppings, such as sour cream, chives, salt and pepper
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
